-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvNodeRule` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def skippedIn (γ : Cluster) (l : List LogEntry) (a b : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] j ∈ List.range' a (b - a), iprop(∀ e, ⌜l[j]? = some e ∧ e.isConfChange⌝ → confDecided γ j ConfDecision.skip)

theorem nodeRunning_stopped [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (q :
    Qp) : isCluster γ N ∗ nodeRunning n γ N q ∗ nodeStopped n γ N ⊢ False

theorem skippedIn_persistent (γ : Cluster) (l : List LogEntry) (a b : Nat) : Persistent (skippedIn γ
    l a b)

def (sealed) confDecided (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : IProp GF

theorem committed_confDecodes [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (l : List
    LogEntry) : isCluster γ N ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ⊢ ⌜∀ (e : LogEntry), e ∈ l → e.isConfChange →
    ConfEntryDecodes e⌝

theorem confDecided_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (d1 d2 : ConfDecision)
    : confDecided γ k d1 ∗ confDecided γ k d2 ⊢ ⌜d1 = d2⌝

theorem confAt_timeless (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) : Timeless (confAt γ k m)

theorem ownConfDecisions_lookup [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (D : GMap Nat
    ConfDecision) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : ownConfDecisions γ D ∗ confDecided γ k d ⊢ ⌜D !! k
    = some d⌝

theorem snapshotCert_made [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (k : SnapTrip) :
    isCluster γ N ∗ snapshotCert γ N k ⊢ ∃ l m, isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ l.length m ∗
    snapMade γ { index := l.length, conf := m, data := k.dat } ∗ ⌜l.length = uint.nat k.sid.index' ∧
    Option.map LogEntry.term l.getLast? = some k.sid.term' ∧ k.cl.Is m ∧ k.al = m.autoLeave⌝

def (sealed) nodeJoin (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) : IProp GF

def (sealed) joinAuth (γ : Cluster) (U : GSet w64) : IProp GF

theorem snapMade_elem [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (S : List SnapRec) (s : SnapRec) :
    ownSnapsMade γ S ∗ snapMade γ s ⊢ ⌜s ∈ S⌝

theorem snapMade_persistent (γ : Cluster) (s : SnapRec) : Persistent (snapMade γ s)

theorem cluster_alloc_dec [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (E : CoPset) :
    receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → vs ≠ [] → vs.Nodup → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs → ↑vs.length < 2 ^ 62 → ⊢
    |={E}=> ∃ γ, ownCommittedOps γ [] ∗ ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ readCredits γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ isCluster γ N
    ∗ ownConfDecisions γ ∅ ∗ confAt γ 0 (Membership.simple (listToSet vs)) ∗ ownSnapsMade γ [] ∗
    leaderTransferOn γ N ∗ joinAuth γ (listToSet vs) ∗ [∗list] id ∈ vs, nodeFounder γ N vs id

theorem confAt_noConf [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (l : List LogEntry) (a b : Nat) (m :
    Membership) : NoConfChangeIn l a b → a ≤ b → b ≤ l.length → isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ a m
    ⊢ confAt γ b m

theorem confAt_decided [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) (d :
    ConfDecision) : confAt γ k m ∗ confDecided γ k d ⊢ ∃ m', ⌜d.step m = some m'⌝ ∗ confAt γ (k + 1)
    m'

def (sealed) confAt (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) : IProp GF

theorem committed_emptyV2_joint [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (l : List
    LogEntry) (k : Nat) (e : LogEntry) (m : Membership) : l[k]? = some e → e.isEmptyV2 → isCluster γ
    N ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ k m ⊢ ⌜m.isJoint⌝

def (sealed) ownConfDecisions (γ : Cluster) (D : GMap Nat ConfDecision) : IProp GF

theorem ownConfDecisions_excl [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (D1 D2 : GMap Nat
    ConfDecision) : ownConfDecisions γ D1 ∗ ownConfDecisions γ D2 ⊢ False

theorem skippedIn_noConf [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (l : List LogEntry) (a b : Nat) :
    NoConfChangeIn l a b → ⊢ skippedIn γ l a b

theorem confAt_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m1 m2 : Membership) :
    confAt γ k m1 ∗ confAt γ k m2 ⊢ ⌜m1 = m2⌝

theorem confDecided_timeless (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : Timeless (confDecided γ k
    d)

def (sealed) nodeFounder (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (id : w64) : IProp GF

theorem joinAuth_join [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (U : GSet w64) (id :
    w64) : ¬id ∈ U → id ≠ W64 0 → ⊢ isCluster γ N ∗ joinAuth γ U ==∗ joinAuth γ ({id} ∪ U) ∗
    nodeJoin γ N id

def (sealed) isCluster (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) : IProp GF

theorem confAt_persistent (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) : Persistent (confAt γ k m)

def (sealed) snapMade (γ : Cluster) (s : SnapRec) : IProp GF

theorem confDecide [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (D : GMap Nat
    ConfDecision) (l : List LogEntry) (k : Nat) (e : LogEntry) (m m' : Membership) (d :
    ConfDecision) : D !! k = none → l[k]? = some e → e.isConfChange → d.step m = some m' → ⊢
    isCluster γ N ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ k m ∗ ownConfDecisions γ D ==∗ ownConfDecisions
    γ <[k := d]>D ∗ confDecided γ k d ∗ confAt γ (k + 1) m'

theorem ownConfDecisions_timeless (γ : Cluster) (D : GMap Nat ConfDecision) : Timeless
    (ownConfDecisions γ D)

theorem ownSnapsMade_timeless (γ : Cluster) (S : List SnapRec) : Timeless (ownSnapsMade γ S)

theorem ownConfDecisions_witness [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (D : GMap Nat
    ConfDecision) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : D !! k = some d → ownConfDecisions γ D ⊢
    ownConfDecisions γ D ∗ confDecided γ k d

theorem confDecided_persistent (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : Persistent (confDecided
    γ k d)

def (sealed) ownSnapsMade (γ : Cluster) (S : List SnapRec) : IProp GF

theorem isCluster_persistent (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) : Persistent (isCluster γ N)

theorem confAt_valid [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) : confAt γ
    k m ⊢ ⌜m.Valid⌝

theorem snapshotCert_make [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (E : CoPset) (l
    : List LogEntry) (i t : w64) (d : List w8) (m : Membership) (cs : ConfStateM) (S : List SnapRec)
    : ↑N ⊆ E → l.length = uint.nat i → Option.map LogEntry.term l.getLast? = some t → SnapListsOk {
    sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := cs.lists, al := m.autoLeave, dat := d } → confStateIs
    cs m → ⊢ isCluster γ N -∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l -∗ confAt γ l.length m -∗ ownSnapsMade γ S ={E}=∗
    ownSnapsMade γ (S ++ [{ index := l.length, conf := m, data := d }]) ∗ snapshotCert γ N { sid :=
    { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := cs.lists, al := m.autoLeave, dat := d }
